gaps.quote: The recursions have constant branching and depth $O(\log p)$
gaps.note: The page never says which recursions are meant (the paper, around line 4920, means the butterfly-layer and address-layout recursions), what a visit is, or what setup is performed per visit. The reader cannot check that the number of visits is at most p^A with setup p^C, nor that the per-record and per-line setup (the paper's O(T p^{A+C}/r) and O(d T p^C / r) terms, lines 4927-4937) is also o(Tp).

gaps.quote: repaired by sorting a compact stream
gaps.note: The page states the repair cost O(V p^{O(1)} 2^{-K}) but not why: the paper (lines 4951-4973) shows the compact exceptional stream has length O(V_call d 2^{-K}), is sorted with O(p) scans, and is summed over at most p^A visits. The reader is not told these facts, so cannot check the p^{O(1)} factor.
